topic: Mobile quest log scroll and perf cleanup
currentUserGoal: Fix the mobile quest log feeling slow and broken, especially the inability to scroll up and down on phones, then push the fix live for testing.
workCompleted: Added a touch-drag scroll path for the Quest Log list using the same pointer identity helper pattern as the mobile skill tree gestures.
Added a Quest Log list hit zone and geometry mask so quest rows scroll within the list viewport instead of visually bleeding under the filter/header UI.
Virtualized Quest Log layout work: only visible quest rows plus a small overscan slice are positioned, resized, and refreshed during scroll.
Cached quest row layout geometry with a layout key so drag scrolling no longer reapplies word wraps, font sizes, and button positions to every row.
Moved quest row visual refresh into a visible-row helper so hidden rows are not formatting progress/reward text every panel refresh.
Stopped ready-row pulse tweens when rows leave the visible quest list or when the Quest Log closes.
Changed shared text buttons to trigger actions on a clean pointer release instead of pointer-down, with a small movement threshold to prevent accidental clicks while dragging.
Connected quest row claim buttons to the Quest Log scroll gesture so dragging from the button area scrolls the list without claiming rewards.
verification: `npm run build` passed after the Quest Log touch scrolling and virtualization changes.
`npm run build` passed after the shared text-button tap-threshold hardening.

knownIssues: The in-app browser can approximate mobile drag gestures but cannot fully reproduce every iOS Safari touch nuance; real device testing is still recommended.

Changing shared text buttons from pointer-down action to clean pointer-up action affects all UI buttons. This is intentional mobile hardening, but broad UI smoke testing on desktop and phone is useful.
The repeatable harness does not specifically open the Quest Log; manual Quest Log mobile stress checks were used for the panel-specific behavior.

doNotRevert: Do not restore Quest Log wheel-only scrolling; mobile needs pointer drag support.
